faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Sussex Spaniel?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 35-45 lb (16-20 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Sussex Spaniel?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD) risk; Ear infections; Heart screening needs. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Sussex Spaniel at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Sussex Spaniel default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
